assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness, raising concern for paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia in the context of a personal history of transient ischemic attacks and cerebral infarction.
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attacks and cerebral infarction.
The symptoms are intermittent in nature.
There is a need to evaluate for potential arrhythmic contributors to prior cerebrovascular events.
Long-term continuous ECG monitoring is indicated to capture any underlying rhythm disturbances.
The long-term continuous ECG monitoring is consistent with the medically necessary long-term continuous electrocardiogram monitoring study represented by CPT code 93247.
The diagnosis codes are Z86.73, G45.9, I47.1.
Z86.73 corresponds to a personal history of transient ischemic attacks and cerebral infarction.
G45.9 corresponds to transient ischemic attacks.
I47.1 corresponds to paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia.
The claim for CPT code 93247 has been denied.
The denial is based on Reason Code PR-204.
The service is not covered under the member's current benefit plan.
Appeals must be submitted in writing within ninety days of this notice.
